experiment_level_boundary.meaningful_experiment: the original Unit 045 prior-VIX relative-regime context audit
experiment_level_boundary.closure_boundary: one corrected authoritative Unit 045 verdict followed by a complete program-map comparison

authority.binding_rule: Implementation defects are corrected and rerun; they are not economic failures.

selection_after_corrected_unit_046.program_2_exception: Unit 045 is not a new external-state hypothesis. Its broad fixed contract never reached one lifecycle metric because of a deterministic PowerShell period-selector tokenization defect.
selection_after_corrected_unit_046.selection_reason: Complete one already-declared, dense, causal and portfolio-wide question without altering its state, source, percentile, threshold, mapping, metric, gate or decision.

invalid_result.role: immutable parser-failure history with zero lifecycle metric

invalid_closure.role: immutable record of the invalid V1 execution

identified_implementation_defect.stage: period row selection before active and pending lifecycle reconstruction
identified_implementation_defect.historical_effect: PowerShell parsed the fused token as a property name and selected zero rows in every period.

inherited_question: Does the most recent strictly prior Cboe VIX daily close, expressed as a causal position within its own trailing 252-session distribution, create a broad LOW or HIGH external-volatility context that materially separates the frozen six-strategy portfolio's 2x-cost stressed R and stop-loss incidence after controlling for strategy and period?

inherited_causal_classification.birth_date: UTC calendar date of OPEN or PASSIVE_FILL
inherited_causal_classification.prior_close: latest Cboe VIX DATE strictly earlier than birth UTC date
inherited_causal_classification.window: exactly 252 available closes ending at the selected prior close
inherited_causal_classification.percentile: count of window closes less than or equal to selected prior close divided by 252

inherited_contract.population: 16,477 exact event rows and 2,233 complete lifecycles with strategy-period-regime classification
inherited_contract.metrics: strategy-period-centered stressed-R and stop residuals for LOW and HIGH, with period and strategy breadth plus contribution concentration
inherited_contract.variant_materiality: absolute 0.10R and 0.05 stop with economic coherence
inherited_contract.breadth: three of four periods and four of six strategies for both return and stop
inherited_contract.density: at least 600 pooled, 80 each period, 30 each strategy and all 24 strategy-period cells
inherited_contract.selection: at most one later entry-preserving VIX-context response question only if one edge state passes every gate
inherited_contract.failure: no VIX-context seed and no threshold, window, percentile, trend, rate-of-change, realized-volatility, alternate-index, strategy, direction, period, event or session rescue

execution_governance.pure_implementation_defects: record exact defect and correction before retry, with no arbitrary numeric cap

excluded: any alternate VIX level, window, percentile, trend, change, realized-volatility or volatility index
any strategy, direction, period, event, session or book subgroup
any filter, lot, slot, risk, exit, EA or Live rule
Program 6, broker/account/position/order/deal queries, Live research ledger and Live surfaces
